2026-11-14: (1) the Site-only surface filter is in, dark. The registry marks a Space block that has no Site render `notOnSite` (today link cards and Donate, both Spotlight-only); `blockRendersOnSite` and `siteSurfaceRows` (lib/entity-blocks) drop those ids from a Site's resolved rows, keeping the row shape. The house Home applies it only with EDITOR_CANVAS on, so with the switch off the Site draws exactly what it drew (site-kind.test.ts). (2) the Site picture is wired, not taken: `editorTargetSurfaces` adds `editor-site` (anon, first screen) from PW_SITE_URL, a published Site's own https origin, read by e2e-manual.yml, because a Site renders only on its own host and never under PW_BASE_URL. Still open: the owner sets the PW_SITE_URL repo variable and dispatches e2e-manual with update_baselines; the probe passes when an editor-site picture is committed. The capture stamp is per base URL, so a Site on production beside a preview base is the owner's call.

2026-11-16: the Site picture is taken and committed. e2e-manual gained a site_url dispatch input (it overrides the PW_SITE_URL repo variable for one run), and run 43891675859 photographed a published Site's Home on its own host (house-of-fates.frequencylocal.com) at desktop and mobile in both public render states; the four editor-site PNGs are under test/e2e/__screenshots__/visual.spec.ts. Only those four files were copied from the capture branch; the other baselines that run rewrote were left alone. Known limits: the picture is first screen only and is a live Site, so the owner editing that Site, or its moon-phase header line changing, moves the picture without any renderer change; the pull request compare does not walk this surface (it needs PW_SITE_URL or the input), so the diff is a manual dispatch.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='test/e2e/__screenshots__/visual.spec.ts';const hit=fs.existsSync(d)&&fs.readdirSync(d).some(f=>/^editor-site/.test(f));if(!hit){console.error('LIVE-2232: no editor-site picture under '+d+' to diff the Site renderer against');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Passes once a Site picture is committed. Measures the zero-visual-diff baseline, the consequence the row exists for.
